item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena dips one hand in a bowl of warm water and her other hand in a bowl of cool water for a minute. She then puts both hands together into a third bowl of water at room temperature.
To one hand the water feels warm and to the other it feels cool, but a thermometer in the third bowl shows one steady reading.
What does this activity show?

options.A: The water in the third bowl is both warm and cool at the same time.
options.B: Our sense of touch cannot always judge hotness or coldness reliably, so temperature must be measured with a thermometer.
options.C: The thermometer reading changes depending on which hand touches the bowl.
options.D: Warm water and cool water mix to make the thermometer stop working.
